blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-agent systems bring together language model agents with different roles to propose, review, and refine solutions. Each agent’s response depends on its model’s capabilities, the reasoning strategy defined by its system prompt, and the information in its input context. Existing frameworks often adapt communication by changing this context while leaving individual prompts fixed, even when a problem calls for different skills. We study whether agents’ initial responses can identify a strategy better suited to the current problem and guide its transfer to other agents. To address this, we introduce SAGE ( S elf- A dapting G roup of E xperts), a training-free framework that uses answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review to select a strategy donor. SAGE transfers the selected donor’s reasoning strategy to the other agents while preserving their original roles. This transfer uses only the agents’ original system prompts, without access to the problem or generated solutions. After strategy adaptation, agents exchange responses through a dynamic, sparse directed acyclic graph that routes information from higher-scoring agents to lower-scoring agents. Experiments across multiple agent backbones and reasoning benchmarks show that SAGE achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated baselines. Our code is available here .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in question answering, coding, and mathematical reasoning ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Qwen Team, 2025 ) . Yet a single response can still contain errors or fail when a problem requires several reasoning steps or knowledge beyond the model’s strengths ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) . Smaller models can excel at particular tasks while struggling with these broader demands ( Magister et al., 2023 ) . These limitations motivate multi-agent systems (MAS), where several LLM-based agents discuss solutions, check one another’s work, and revise their answers ( Li et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ) . By combining different models or roles, such systems can draw on varied expertise and solve problems that individual agents miss ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) . The challenge is to match the team’s reasoning strategies and collaboration to the needs of each problem.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在回答问题,编码和数学推理方面取得了实质性进展(OpenAI,2024;Grattafiori等人,2024;Quen Team,2025). 然而,当一个问题需要多个推理步骤或超越模型优势的知识时,单一的反应仍然可以包含错误或失败(Wang等人,2023年;Hendrycks等人,2021a年)。 较小的模型在应付这些更广泛的需求的同时,能够出色地完成特定任务(Magister等人,2023年)。 这些限制刺激了多剂系统(MAS),其中几个基于LLM的代理商讨论解决方案,互相检查工作,并修改答案(Li等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年;Du等人,2024年)。 通过结合不同的模式或作用,这种系统可以利用各种专门知识,解决个别代理人错过的问题(Chen等人,2024年;Yue等人,2025年)。 挑战在于使小组的推理战略与合作符合每个问题的需求。

blocks.en:
Recent work seeks useful, efficient communication, since more discussion does not always improve answers ( Smit et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024b ) . To shape communication, GPTSwarm optimizes links and prompts, AgentPrune removes unnecessary links ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and G-Designer generates a graph for each problem using a learned model ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
SelfOrg rebuilds the graph each round, favoring agents whose response embeddings align with the group average (centroid) ( Tastan et al., 2026 ) .
Beyond connections, MOC preserves messages from directly and indirectly connected agents without repetition ( Guan et al., 2026 ) , while MAD-M 2 filters potentially incorrect history without adapting role instructions ( Tian et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en:
An agent’s response depends on three components:
(i) its underlying model, which determines its learned capabilities;
(ii) its role-defining system instructions, which guide how it
approaches a problem; and
(iii) the problem-specific input context, including the problem statement
and any previous or peer responses.
Changing the communication structure changes which peer responses
an agent receives, but does not by itself revise its role instructions.
Although prior work also explores role and prompt adaptation,
we investigate how agents’ responses to the current problem can
guide the transfer of useful reasoning instructions across roles.
This fully utilizes the capability of the agents by allowing them to adapt their reasoning strategies.

Based on the aforementioned idea, we introduce a reference agent, which we call a strategy donor , whose original role instructions may benefit other agents. To see how this conceptually works, consider the following physics problem: An object of mass m m is dropped from rest from a height h h .
Air resistance opposes its motion with magnitude k ​ v 2 kv^{2} ,
where k > 0 k>0 is a constant and v v is its speed.
What is its speed just before it hits the ground? Suppose the agents are assigned the roles of a physicist,
a mathematician, and a computer scientist.
The physicist’s original role prompt might instruct it to identify
the relevant forces and formulate governing equations from
physical laws (Newtonian dynamics), which clarifies the underlying mechanics of the problem as a function of m , h , k m,h,k , and v v .

The mathematician could incorporate this guidance while retaining

could focus on numerical solutions for the simulated dynamics.
Such collaboration further benefits from multi-turn interactions, in which agents iteratively refine their responses based on feedback from their peers.

blocks.en: We introduce SAGE ( S elf- A dapting G roup of E xperts), a training-free framework that (i) selects a strategy donor from the agents’ independent initial responses using answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review; (ii) uses the donor’s original system prompt to revise the other agents’ strategies while preserving their inherent roles; (iii) constructs a sparse directed acyclic graph, rebuilt after every collaboration round, that routes responses from higher-scoring agents to lower-scoring agents. This creates a self-adaptive multi-agent system that adjusts how each individual agent reasons, adapts, and collaborates for each problem without relying on any training or external judge model.

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: SAGE adapts the reasoning strategies of the agents and their collaboration structure for each problem in three stages. First, a strategy donor is selected among the agents based on their independent initial responses, which are evaluated using answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review (Section 2.1 ). Second, the donor’s original system prompt is used to adapt the other agents’ strategies while preserving their roles (Section 2.2 ). Finally, the agents propagate their responses (based on their updated system prompts) via a sparse directed acyclic communication graph and their responses are refined over multiple collaboration rounds (Section 2.3 ). While prompt/strategy adaptation is performed once per problem, the communication graph is repeatedly updated between collaboration rounds. The procedure does not require any training or an external judge model. Figure 1 illustrates the workflow, and Algorithm 1 summarizes the procedure.
blocks.zh: SAGE分三个阶段调整了代理商的推理策略和每个问题的合作结构. 首先,根据独立的初步答复,从各机构中挑选战略捐助方,这些初步答复通过答复协议、前缀一致性和同行对等审查进行评估(第2.1节)。 第二,捐助方最初的系统即时用来调整其他代理人的战略,同时保留其作用(第2.2节)。 最后,这些代理人(根据其更新的系统提示)通过一个稀疏的定向循环通信图传播其反应,并且通过多轮协作改进了其反应(第2.3节)。 虽然每个问题都进行迅速/战略调整,但在合作回合之间不断更新通信图。 该程序不需要任何培训或外部法官模式。 图1说明了工作流程,算法1概述了程序。

blocks.en: We evaluate whether SAGE improves reasoning across tasks and backbones, and how its benefits change with model scale, unreliable peer messages, mixed teams, and visual inputs (Appendix G.1 ).

blocks.en: Our main evaluation covers mathematical reasoning with GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021b ) , GSM-Hard ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , and AQuA-RAT ( Ling et al., 2017 ) , together with knowledge and scientific reasoning on MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) and GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2024 ) . We use Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) and Ministral-3-3B-Instruct ( Liu et al., 2026 ) as the main backbones. Baselines include a single model call (Single), chain-of-thought (CoT) ( Wei et al., 2023 ) , and the multi-agent methods SelfOrg ( Tastan et al., 2026 ) , MOC ( Guan et al., 2026 ) , MAD-M 2 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) , and G-Designer ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Single and CoT provide reference points for reasoning without collaboration, while the multi-agent baselines span different approaches to communication and memory. Amongst all baselines compared, SelfOrg is the closest to SAGE . Unlike the fixed random DAG of MOC or the learned graph of G-Designer, both methods require no training and rebuild their DAG in every round from the agents’ current responses. We have described our evaluation protocol in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们的主要评价包括GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),MATH(Hendrycks等人,2021年b),GSM-Hard(Gao等人,2023年),AQuA-RAT(Ling等人,2017年)的数学推理,以及关于MMLU(Hendrycks等人,2021年a)和GPQA-Diamond(Rein等人,2024年)的知识和科学推理. 我们以Quen2.5-1.5B-Instruct(Quen Team,2025年)和Ministry-3-3B-Instruct(Liu等人,2026年)为主要骨干. 基线包括单一模式调用(Single)、思维链(CoT)(Wei等人,2023年)和多剂方法SelfOrg(Tastan等人,2026年),MOC (Guan et al., 2026),MAD-M 2 (Tian et al., 2026),以及G-Designer (Zhang et al., 2025b). 单一和CoT为没有协作的推理提供了参考点,而多代理基线则跨越了不同的通信和记忆方法. 在比较的所有基线中,SelfOrg是最接近SAGE的. 与MOC的固定随机DAG或G-Designer的学习图不同的是,这两种方法都不需要训练,并且从代理商当前的反应中在每个回合中重建DAG. 我们在附录C中描述了我们的评估议定书。

blocks.en: 3.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.1 主要成果

blocks.en: We evaluate SAGE across six reasoning benchmarks using two main backbones, then examine its behavior as team size, model size, team composition, and message reliability change. Additional vision-language results are reported in the Appendix G.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们用两大骨干来评估SAGE的六个推理基准,然后检查它作为团队规模,模型规模,团队组成,以及消息可靠性变化的行为. 附录G.1报告了其他的视觉语言成果。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that SAGE achieves the highest average accuracy on both backbones. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, it improves on the strongest multi-agent baseline, MAD-M 2 , by + 4.9 +4.9 points and outperforms every multi-agent baseline on all six benchmarks. With Ministral-3-3B, the multi-agent baselines perform similarly, and SAGE improves on the strongest of them by + 1.3 +1.3 points. SAGE also consistently outperforms SelfOrg, its closest methodological competitor, with gains of + 5.2 +5.2 points on Qwen2.5-1.5B and + 2.0 +2.0 points on Ministral-3-3B.
blocks.zh: 表1显示SAGE在两个骨干上都实现了最高的平均精度. 有了Quen2.5-1.5B,它改进了最强的多剂基线MAD-M 2,增加了+4.9+4.9分,并且超过了所有六个基准的每个多剂基线。 随着Ministry-3-3B的出现,多剂基线的性能类似,SAGE在其中最强者上提高了1.3+1.3分. SAGE也一贯超越其最接近的方法竞争对手SelfOrg,在Quen2.5-1.5B上得分+5.2+5.2分,在Ministry-3-3B上得分+2.0+2.0分.

blocks.en:
These results show that SAGE is beneficial when the agents are weak. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, none of the evaluated multi-agent baselines outperforms a single model call in macro-average accuracy across the six benchmarks, whereas SAGE does.
On Ministral-3-3B, all evaluated multi-agent methods outperform Single. Relative to SelfOrg, which also rebuilds a response-dependent DAG each round, SAGE improves macro-average accuracy by 5.19 and 2.01 points, respectively.
This comparison supports the effectiveness of our proposed framework compared with SelfOrg’s framework.
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,SAGE在物剂薄弱时是有好处的. 在Quen2.5-1.5B上,所评估的多剂基线中没有任何一个比六个基准的宏观平均准确性高于一个单一模型,而SAGE则如此。
在Ministry-3-3B上,所有被评价的多剂方法都优于Single. 相对于SelfOrg,它也重建了每回合一个依赖响应的DAG,SAGE将宏观平均精度分别提高5.19和2.01分.
与SelfOrg的框架相比,这一比较证明我们拟议框架的有效性。

blocks.en:
We further analyze SAGE’s components in Appendix H .
Across the two main backbones, removing prompt adaptation reduces macro-average accuracy
by 2.10 2.10 – 2.18 2.18 percentage points, while restricting weighted pool voting to the final round reduces it by 0.36 0.36 – 0.79 0.79 points. Additional analyses examine the contribution of donor selection and which roles are selected as donors.
These results characterize the contributions of SAGE’s adaptation, donor-selection, and answer-aggregation mechanisms.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步分析附录H中SAGE的成分。
在两个主要主干线上,迅速取消适应降低了宏观平均准确性
以2.10 2.10 – 2.18 2.18个百分点计算,同时将加权池投票限制在最后一轮时,则减少0.36 0.36 – 0.79 0.79个百分点。 其他分析审查了捐助者选择的贡献以及选择哪些角色为捐助者。
这些成果是SAGE适应、捐助者选择和答复汇总机制的贡献。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Effect of scaling the number of agents. We evaluate SAGE across six reasoning benchmarks with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (top) and Ministral-3-3B-Instruct (bottom) as the number of agents increases from 4 to 9. Accuracy generally improves with more agents on both backbones.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 扩大代理数量的效果。 随着代理商数量从4个增加到9个,我们对SAGE的评价分为6个推理基准,其中Qwen2.5-1.5B-指令(上层)和Ministry-3-3B-指令(下层). 准确性一般会随着两个骨干上更多的代理而提高.

blocks.en: 3.2 Scaling the Number of Agents
blocks.zh: 3.2 扩大代理人人数

blocks.en: We study how SAGE scales with team size by increasing the number of agents from 4 to 9 with both backbones, keeping the questions and all other settings fixed. Figure 2 shows that accuracy generally improves as agents are added. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, the average accuracy rises by + 1.5 +1.5 points from four to nine agents, with the largest gains on AQuA-RAT and GSM-Hard. With Ministral-3-3B, it rises by + 1.8 +1.8 points, with the largest gains on GPQA-Diamond and MMLU.
blocks.zh: 我们研究SAGE如何用团队规模,将代理从4个增加到9个,同时兼有骨干,使问题和所有其他设置固定. 图2显示,随着剂的添加,精度普遍提高. 使用Quen2.5-1.5B,平均精度从4个到9个剂位上升+1.5+1.5点,在AQuA-RAT和GSM-Hard上收益最大. 随着Ministry-3-3B,它上升了+1.8+1.8分,在GPQA-Diamond和MMLU上收获最多.

blocks.en:
These gains may reflect how SAGE uses additional agents.
First, each new agent contributes an independently generated initial response, providing more responses for computing answer agreement. Second, each brings a distinct role prompt, expanding the set of reasoning strategies available for donor selection.
These additions may help the team identify useful answers and strategies. Meanwhile, each agent still reads at most two parent responses per round, so increasing team size does not increase this per-agent communication limit by design of SAGE .
blocks.zh:
这些收益可能反映SAGE如何使用额外的剂.
首先,每个新代理人都贡献了独立生成的初始响应,为计算答案协议提供了更多的响应. 第二,每个方案都带来独特的迅速作用,扩大了可供选择捐助者使用的一套推理战略。
这些补充可能有助于小组确定有用的答案和战略。 同时,每个代理商每轮最多仍读两个母响应,因此增加团队规模不会通过设计SAGE来增加这个每代理商通信限制.

blocks.en: 3.3 Scaling the Backbone Size
blocks.zh: 3.3 缩放后骨大小

blocks.en: Figure 3: Backbone scaling. We compare Single and SAGE on GSM-Hard and GPQA-Diamond using Qwen2.5-Instruct models ranging from 0.5B to 72B parameters. The table reports mean ± \pm sample SD over three runs, with the higher mean in bold; the plots show the same results with evenly spaced model sizes.
blocks.zh: 图3:背骨缩放。 我们使用0.5B至72B参数的Quen2.5-Instruct模型对GSM-Hard和GPQA-Diamond上的Single和SAGE进行比较. 表格报告显示的是 ±\pm 抽样SD 超过 3 个运行, 以粗体表示的平均值较高; 平方块显示的模型大小均匀。

blocks.en: We evaluate Qwen2.5-Instruct backbones from 0.5B to 72B on GSM-Hard and GPQA-Diamond. We keep the number of agents, parent limit, and round limit fixed (Figure 3 ). On GSM-Hard, SAGE outperforms Single at every model size, with gains ranging from 1.2 to 5.0 percentage points. At 32B, it also exceeds the accuracy of Single at 72B (62.20% versus 60.40%), although this comparison does not imply lower inference cost.
blocks.zh: 我们在GSM-Hard和GPQA-Diamond上评价Quen2.5-指令骨干从0.5B到72B. 我们保留代理数量、母限和圆限(图3)。 在GSM- Hard 上, SAGE 表现优于 每个模型大小均为单倍,收益从1.2至5.0个百分点不等. 在32B时,它也超过了Single在72B时的准确度(62.20%对60.40%),虽然这一比较并不意味着推论成本较低.

blocks.en:
On GPQA-Diamond, the effect is less consistent. The largest gain occurs at 0.5B, where accuracy increases from 22.56% to 31.14%, but SAGE has lower mean accuracy than Single at 3B and 32B.
Overall, SAGE demonstrates some benefit over single-agent performance, particularly with smaller backbones.
blocks.zh:
在GPQA-Diamond上,效果不太一致. 最大的增益发生在0.5B,其精度从22.56%提高到31.14%,但SAGE的平均精度低于Single 3B和32B.
总体而言,SAGE显示出一些优于单一代理业绩的好处,特别是在骨干较小的情况下。

blocks.en: 3.4 Lifting Teams with Weak Agents
blocks.zh: 3.4 具有薄弱代理人的升迁小组

blocks.en: We evaluate SAGE with a heterogeneous team of nine agents (three each from Qwen2.5-1.5B, Ministral-3-3B, and Phi-4-mini) and compare it with homogeneous nine-agent teams of each backbone on GSM8K and MMLU. As Figure 4 shows, the mixed team performs close to the strongest homogeneous team, Ministral, even though only a third of its agents use Ministral. It also outperforms the homogeneous Qwen and Phi teams on both benchmarks and on average exceeds the mean of the three homogeneous teams by about + 5 +5 points.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个由9名特工(来自Quen2.5-1.5B、Ministry-3-3B和Phi-4-mini各3名特工)组成的多样化团队来评估SAGE,并将其与GSM8K和MMLU上每个骨干组的均匀的9名特工团队进行比较。 如图4所示,混合团队的演练接近最强的同质团队Ministry,尽管只有三分之一的代理人使用Ministry. 在两个基准上,它也优于同质的Quen和Phi队伍,平均比三个同质队伍的平均值高出5+5分左右.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Accuracy by team composition. Accuracy (%) for nine-agent teams on GSM8K and MMLU (one run). Q/M/P counts Qwen/Ministral/Phi agents; H denotes the mixed team. AVG is the benchmark mean; bold/underlined values mark best/second best.
blocks.zh: 图4:按团队组成分列的准确性。 GSM8K和MMLU(一跑)的9支代理团队的精确度(%). Q/M/P计算Quen/Ministry/Phi代理;H表示混合团队. AVG是基准平均值;粗体/下划线值标为最佳/第二最佳.

blocks.en: This shows that SAGE can achieve strong team performance even when most of its agents use weaker backbones. It does not need to know in advance which backbone is strongest, because it scores agents based on their responses to each problem. Ministral agents supply most donors ( 72 % 72\% on GSM8K and 65 % 65\% on MMLU), although they make up only a third of the team, while donors are also selected from other backbones. Messages flow only from higher-scoring to lower-scoring agents, so lower-scoring agents cannot directly pass their answers to higher-scoring ones, but they can still use higher-scoring agents’ responses and the donor’s guidance to revise their own answers. The weaker backbones may also add value. If different models make different mistakes, agreement across model families may provide useful evidence for an answer. These experiments demonstrate that SAGE performs close to a team built entirely from the strongest model.
blocks.zh: 这表明SAGE即使其大部分代理使用较弱的骨干,也能实现强大的团队表现. 它不需要事先知道哪个支柱最强,因为它根据代理人对每个问题的反应来评分。 大多数捐赠者(GSM8K占72%,MMLU占65%)是政府代理人,尽管他们只占团队的三分之一,而捐赠者也从其他骨干中挑选。 消息只从得分较高的代理人流向得分较低的代理人,所以得分较低的代理人不能直接将答案传递给得分较高的代理人,但是他们仍然可以利用得分较高的代理人的答复和捐赠者的指导来修改自己的答案. 骨干薄弱也可能增加价值。 如果不同的模型会犯不同的错误,模范家庭之间的协议可以为答案提供有用的证据. 这些实验表明SAGE的表演接近一个完全由最强模型组成的团队.

blocks.en: 3.5 Robustness to Adversarial Attacks
blocks.zh: 3.5 对抗性袭击的力量

blocks.en: Figure 5: Message corruption. SAGE and SelfOrg across five benchmarks with three of nine agents corrupted. Bars show means; error bars show sample SD over three runs.
blocks.zh: 图5:信息腐败。 SAGE和SelfOrg跨越5个基准,9个特工中有3个腐败. 栏显示表示;错误栏显示样品SD在三跑.

blocks.en: We test whether SAGE stays reliable when some agents deliberately mislead the team. In a nine-agent Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct team, three randomly chosen agents are corrupted. Each replaces the final answer in every message it shares with a fixed wrong answer and claims that this answer is correct. SAGE and SelfOrg face the same corrupted agents and wrong answers on five benchmarks. Appendix C describes the full protocol.
blocks.zh: 当一些特工故意误导团队时 我们测试SAGE是否可靠 在一支9名特务的Quen2.5-1.5B-指导团队中,有3名随机选择的特务腐败. 每个词都用一个固定错误的答案来取代每一个信息中的最后答案,并声称这个答案是正确的. SAGE和SelfOrg面对同样腐败的特工,在五个基准上回答错误. 附 录 C描述了完整的协议.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows that SAGE outperforms SelfOrg on all five benchmarks under message corruption. The gains are largest on AQuA-RAT ( + 5.8 +5.8 points) and MATH ( + 4.3 +4.3 points), and SAGE also improves on GSM8K, MMLU, and GSM-Hard. These results suggest that SAGE can retain an advantage over SelfOrg under the tested corruption protocol, without a separate attack detector. Answer agreement and prefix consistency may help
limit the influence of corrupted messages when injected answers
disagree with peer responses or are inconsistent with the preceding
reasoning. If these signals assign a corrupted agent a low score,
its outgoing connections are restricted by the routing rule.
In addition, the rewriter sees only the original role prompts,
so injected response text is excluded from its input.
However, corrupted responses may still affect donor selection.
blocks.zh:
图5显示,SAGE在信息腐败下的所有5个基准上都超过了自律。 AQuA-RAT(+5.8+5.8分)和MATH(+4.3+4.3分)的增益最大,SAGE在GSM8K,MMLU和GSM-Hard上也有改善. 这些结果表明SAGE可以保留在测试的腐败协议下相对于SelfOrg的优势,没有单独的攻击探测器. 回答协议和前缀一致性可能有所帮助
输入答案时限制已损坏消息的影响
不同意同行反应或与前述不一致
逻辑。 如果这些信号给腐败的特工分配了低分
它的输出连接受路由规则的限制。
此外,重写者只看到最初的角色提示,
因此,输入的响应文本被排除在其输入之外。
然而,腐败的反应仍然可能影响捐助者的选择。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We presented SAGE , a training-free framework that adapts expert instructions and communication for multi-agent reasoning. Guided by evidence from the agents’ responses, SAGE transfers reasoning strategies between role prompts while preserving each expert’s specialization, then coordinates their collaboration through a dynamic sparse graph. Experiments across multiple backbones and text and vision-language benchmarks demonstrate improvements over the evaluated single and multi-agent baselines. These findings support combining adaptation of expert instructions with response-dependent communication to improve collaborative reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了SAGE,这是一个免费培训的框架,它适应了专家指示和交流,用于多代理推理。 SAGE以代理商反应中的证据为指导,在保持每位专家专业性的同时,在角色提示之间转移推理策略,然后通过动态稀疏的图表协调他们的合作。 跨越多个主干线以及文本和愿景语言基准的实验表明,与所评估的单一和多代理人基线相比,情况有所改善。 这些结论支持将调整专家指示与基于应对的沟通结合起来,以改进协作推理。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies training-free coordination among existing language and vision-language models on established reasoning benchmarks. We do not conduct human-subject experiments or collect new personal data. Agent agreement and prefix consistency provide imperfect evidence of response quality, and collaboration can reinforce errors or biases shared by the underlying models. The robustness findings are limited to the tested setting of fixed, non-adaptive misleading messages. Applications involving consequential decisions require independent validation of the system’s outputs.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了现有语言和视觉语言模型在既定推理基准方面的无培训协调。 我们不进行人类实验或收集新的个人数据。 代理协议和前缀一致性为反应质量提供了不完善的证据,协作可以强化基础模型共有的错误或偏差. 强性结论仅限于测试固定的,非适应性的误导性信息的设置. 涉及相应决定的应用程序需要对系统的产出进行独立验证。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en: A.1 Multi-Agent Reasoning
blocks.zh: A.1 多代理人理由

blocks.en: Test-time reasoning methods improve a single model by eliciting intermediate steps or aggregating several samples ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Multi-agent systems instead distribute reasoning across several model instances. Role-based frameworks assign agents different responsibilities and organize their interaction through structured workflows ( Li et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ) . Debate methods ask agents to compare arguments and revise their answers over several rounds ( Du et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) . ReConcile combines diverse models through discussion and confidence-aware answer aggregation ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , while Exchange-of-Thought studies different ways to share intermediate reasoning ( Yin et al., 2023 ) . Other work improves performance by scaling and aggregating independent or layered agents ( Li et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . However, debate does not always outperform simpler answer-aggregation schemes and can be sensitive to its setup ( Smit et al., 2024 ) . SAGE keeps distinct agent roles but adapts their prompts to the current problem before collaboration.
blocks.zh: 试验时间推理方法通过引出中间步骤或汇总几个样本来改进单一模型(Wang等人,2023年). 多代理系统转而将推理分布在几个模型中. 基于作用的框架通过结构化的工作流程分配不同的责任,并组织互动(Li等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年;Hong等人,2024年)。 辩论方法要求代理商在几轮中比较争论并修改答案(Du等人,2024年;梁等人,2024年). Reconcile通过讨论和信心解答汇总(Chen et al., 2024)结合了多种模式(Chen et al., 2024),而思想交流研究则以不同的方式分享中间推理(Yin et al., 2023). 其他工作通过缩放和集聚独立或分层的物剂提高性能(Li等人,2024a); 王等, 2025 (中文(简体) ). 然而,辩论并不总是比简单的解答-汇总计划做得更好,而且可以对其设置敏感(Smit等人,2024年)。 SAGE保留了不同的代理角色,但在合作前调整他们的提示以适应当前的问题.

blocks.en: A.2 Prompt Optimization
blocks.zh: A.2 迅速优化

blocks.en: Automatic prompt optimization (APE) ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) reduces the need for manual prompt design. APE generates and selects candidate instructions, while ProTeGi edits prompts using feedback from model errors ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ) . OPRO improves instructions using earlier prompts and their scores, and PromptBreeder evolves both task prompts and the prompts used to modify them ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Fernando et al., 2024 ) . PRewrite trains a prompt rewriter with reinforcement learning, PRomPTed adapts prompts to individual instances, and SPRIG optimizes reusable system prompts ( Kong et al., 2024 ; Srivastava et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 自动快速优化(APE)(周等人,2023年)减少了人工快速设计的需求. APE生成并选择候选指令,而ProTeGi则使用模型错误的反馈来编辑提示(Pryzant等人,2023年). OPRO使用更早的提示及其分数改进指令,FourceBreeder既演化了任务提示,也演化了用于修改这些提示的提示(Yang等人,2024年;Fernando等人,2024年). PRewrite训练一个具有强化学习的快速重写器,PRomPTed根据个别实例调整了提示,SPRIG优化了可重复使用的系统提示(Kong等人,2024年;Srivastava等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2026年a).

blocks.en: Prompt optimization has also been studied in multi-agent systems. HiveMind updates agent prompts using contribution estimates, MAPRO jointly refines prompts using topology-aware feedback, and MASS interleaves prompt and topology optimization ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, SAGE performs one adaptation stage for each problem. The agents’ responses determine the prompt donor, but the rewriter does not receive the problem or generated solutions.
blocks.zh: 还在多剂系统中研究了即时优化。 HiveMind利用捐款估计数更新代理提示,MAPRO利用地貌意识反馈联合改进了提示,MASS交互叶片即时和地形优化(Xia等人,2026年;张等人,2026年b;周等人,2026年). 相比之下,SAGE对每个问题进行一个适应阶段. 代理商的反应决定了迅速的捐赠者,但重写者没有收到问题或产生解决办法。

blocks.en: A.3 Multi-Agent Communication and Coordination
blocks.zh: A.3 多方代理通信和协调

blocks.en: Communication structure determines which agents exchange information and how their responses are combined. Prior work studies fixed patterns such as sparse neighbor graphs, layered aggregation, and directed acyclic graphs ( Li et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2025 ) . More adaptive methods select agents or communication paths for each query ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) . Other approaches optimize graph edges, prune redundant messages, generate task-specific topologies, or jointly search prompts and communication structures ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . SelfOrg instead builds its graph from the agents’ current responses ( Tastan et al., 2026 ) . SAGE follows this response-based view, but also adapts the agents’ role prompts before collaboration.
blocks.zh: 通信结构决定了哪些代理人交换信息,以及他们的答复如何合并。 以往的工作研究固定规律,如稀疏的邻图,分层聚合,以及定向环形图(Li等人,2024b;Wang等人,2025;Qian等人,2025). 更具适应性的方法为每个查询选择代理或通信路径(刘等人,2024年;岳等人,2025年)。 其他方法优化图边,prune冗余消息,生成任务特定的地形,或联合搜索提示和通信结构(诸葛亮等人,2024年;张等人,2025年a;张等人,2025年b;周等人,2026年). SelfOrg转而根据毒剂目前的反应绘制其图表(Tastan等人,2026年)。 SAGE遵循这种基于响应的观点,但也在协作前调整了代理角色提示.

blocks.en: SAGE uses four agents with distinct roles, sampled without replacement for each problem from a shared pool. The pool covers problem parsing, algebra, arithmetic, discrete mathematics, geometry and precalculus, competition mathematics, multiple-choice reasoning, academic knowledge, and verification. Each agent retains its role identity and backbone throughout inference. blocks.en: All methods use the same evaluation examples within each comparison. In the main study, the multi-agent methods share four roles sampled from a common pool and a three-round limit; SelfOrg and SAGE also share a two-parent limit. We match task-generation settings within each backbone, while retaining each method’s inference procedure. Total inference cost varies with the additional operations used by each method.

blocks.en: For the main text benchmarks, xFinder-qwen1505 ( Yu et al., 2025 ) extracts answers and xVerify-0.5B-I ( Chen et al., 2025 ) evaluates correctness. We evaluate SAGE ’s weighted-pool-vote answer. For the main comparison, we report accuracy as mean ± \pm sample standard deviation over three runs on fixed examples, and use the unweighted mean of the six benchmark accuracies as the macro-average. Comparisons describe observed means unless a confidence interval is explicitly reported.
blocks.zh: 对于正文基准,xFinder-qwen1505(Yu等人,2025年)摘录答案,xVerify-0.5B-I(Chen等人,2025年)评价正确性. 我们评价SAGE的加权组合投票答案。 对于主要比较,我们报告精确度为3个固定实例上的平均值±\pm样本标准偏差,并以6个基准值的未加权平均值作为宏观平均值。 比较说明观察到的手段,除非明确报告信任间隔。

blocks.en: The corruption study in Section 3.5 uses nine Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct agents with K = 3 K=3 and T = 3 T=3 , and evaluates 200 fixed examples per benchmark over three runs. For each example and run, three of the nine agents are corrupted, chosen by a seeded random permutation of the roles. Before inference, each corrupted agent is assigned its own wrong answer: a perturbed value for numerical answers, a fixed incorrect expression for symbolic answers, and an incorrect option for multiple-choice questions. Each wrong answer is checked to be scored as incorrect. Only this preparation step reads the reference answers; inference receives the wrong answers but no reference.
blocks.zh: 第3.5节中的腐败问题研究使用了9个使用K=3 K=3和T=3 的Quen2.5-1.5B-指令代理,并在3次运行中评价每个基准200个固定实例。 对于每一个例子和运行,九个代理中有三个是腐败的,由角色的种子随机演化选择. 推论前,每个腐败的代理人都会被分配到自己的错误答案:数字答案的扰动值,符号答案的固定不正确的表达,以及多个选择问题的不正确的选项. 每个错误的答案都被检查为不正确 。 只有这个准备步骤读取参考答案;推论收到错误的答案,但没有引用.

blocks.en: During inference, a corrupted agent’s model call runs normally, but its response is modified before it is shared. Every boxed value is replaced by the assigned wrong answer, the response ends with this answer as its final answer, and a line is added stating that competing conclusions were reviewed and this conclusion is the most defensible. The modification applies to initial responses, collaboration-round responses, and, for SAGE , peer-review responses, which are also marked as edits. Prefix-consistency completions are not modified, so the attack targets the shared messages rather than the agent’s model. The attack does not adapt to the method: SAGE and SelfOrg receive identical corrupted agents and wrong answers. We also verify that no injected text reaches SAGE ’s prompt rewriter, which receives only role prompts. After inference, a deterministic answer extractor scores the final answers against the reference answers.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,一个腐败的代理商的模型调用正常运行,但其反应在共享之前被修改. 每个框值被指定错误的答案所取代,反应以这个答案作为最终答案结束,并添加一条线,表示对相互竞争的结论进行了审查,这个结论是最合理的. 该修改适用于初始响应,合作回合响应,对于SAGE,同行审查响应,也标注为编辑. 前缀一致性的完成没有修改,因此攻击针对的是共享的信息而不是代理的模型. 攻击不适应方法:SAGE和SelfOrg接收相同的腐败特工和错误的答案. 我们还确认,没有注入的文本到达SAGE的即时重写器,它只接收角色提示。 推论后,一个决定性的答案提取器根据参考答案对最终答案进行评分.

blocks.en: The larger gain occurs on MathVista, where SAGE improves on SelfOrg by about 6.1 6.1 percentage points (Table 3 ), supporting the use of adaptive collaboration for visual mathematical reasoning.
